name: ceramics-webapp

dependencies.description: Backend API for catalog, cart, checkout, orders, and admin management.
dependencies.name: ceramics-api

dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client for shopper and admin sign-in (guest checkout does not require it).
dependencies.name: user-auth

description: React single-page app serving both the customer-facing storefront (catalog browse/search, product detail, cart, guest or signed-in checkout, order confirmation, order history) and the store admin console (catalog and inventory management, order list, fulfillment status updates) behind role-gated screens. Talks only to ceramics-api; holds no direct database or payment credentials. Does not process payments or send email itself — those are server-side concerns of ceramics-api.
